Substituent_Group: A-ring replaced with pyridine; C-8 substituted with 2-pyridylthio (-S-2-pyridyl)
Activity_IC50_CC50: D6: IC50=0.25 uM (A549); Parent Tryp IC50=6.45 uM; HEK-293 CC50=8.77 uM
Key_Observation: ~25-fold potency increase over parent. Suppresses EGFR phosphorylation, G2/M arrest, ROS-mediated apoptosis. Low toxicity to normal cells.

Activity_IC50_CC50: 8-Nitrotryp (48h): HCT116 IC50=0.86 uM, SW480 IC50=0.81 uM; Parent Tryp: HCT116 IC50=4.60 uM, SW480 IC50=42.13 uM
Key_Observation: C-8 nitro dramatically enhances antiproliferative activity (5x HCT116, >50x SW480). Dual-inhibits TGF-b/SMAD2 and PI3K/AKT/mTOR; blocks EMT.
Nanomolar IDO inhibitor. Triggers mitochondrial ICD with caspase-3/9. Outperforms Dox (0.89 uM) and Dau (1.09 uM).
